PHYSICAL AND HEALTH EDUCATION
BASIC SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
SECOND TERM
PRIMARY 6
THEME: GAMES AND SPORTS
PREVIOUS LESSON - As stated in Second Term (Term 2) Week 1 Plan Lesson Notes for Primary Schools
TOPIC: HOCKEY
LEARNING AREA
1. Introduction
2. History of Hockey in Nigeria
3. Facilities and Equipment of Hockey
4. Advantages of Playing Hockey Game
5. Safety Measures in Playing Hockey Game
6. Lesson Evaluation and Weekly Assessment (Test)
PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES
By the end of the lesson, the pupils should have attained the following objectives -
1. narrate the history of hockey in Nigeria;
2. state hockey facilities and equipment;
3. draw and label the hockey pitch with dimensions.
4. perform the basic skills in hockey.
5. mention the advantages of playing hockey game.
6. safety measures in playing hockey game.
ENTRY BEHAVIOR
The pupils can differentiate between hockey game and other ball games.
INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIALS
The teacher will teach the lesson with the aid of:
1. Textbook
2. Charts
3. Pictures
4. Video clips
5. Hockey pitch
6. Hockey sticks
7. Hockey ball
8. Whistle
9. Stop watch
METHOD OF TEACHING
Choose a suitable and appropriate methods for the lessons.
Note - Irrespective of choosing methods of teaching, always introduce an activities that will arouse pupil’s interest or lead them to the lessons.
REFERENCE MATERIALS
Scheme of Work
9 - Years Basic Education Curriculum
Course Book
All Relevant Material
Online Information
CONTENT OF THE LESSON
LESSON 1 - INTRODUCTION
Hockey is a sport in which two teams play against each other by trying to maneuver a ball into the opponent’s side using a hockey stick.
There are different types of hockey -
1. Field hockey
2. Ice hockey
HISTORY OF HOCKEY IN NIGERIA
Hockey game was introduced into Nigeria by European in 1928, who introduced and played the game in various schools and colleges in the country.
Hockey became regular feature in inter-house sport competitions of Kings’ College, Igbobi College and St. Gregory’s College, and with some army unit teams, friendly matches were being conducted.
The Nigeria Hockey Federation (NHF) is the governing body of Field Hockey in Nigeria. It is affiliated to IHF International Hockey Federation and AHF African Hockey Federation. The headquarter of NHF is in Abuja, Nigeria.
LESSON 2 - FACILITIES AND EQUIPMENT
1. Hockey stick  and ball
2. Protector (helmet/facemask with mouth guard, neck guard, shoulder/elbow/shin pads, gloves, paint)
3. Shoes (field and ice)
4. Hhistle
5. Hockey pitch
BASIC SKILLS IN HOCKEY
1. Gripping
2. First touch
3. Hitting
4. Passing
5. Dribbling
6. Flat stick tackle
7. Defending
8. Positioning
LESSON 3 - ADVANTAGES OF PLAYING HOCKEY GAME
1. It helps to burn fat and calories.
2. It helps muscular strength.
3. It helps full body workout.
4. It helps to develop eyes coordination.
5. It helps to develop body coordination and balance.
6. It helps to boost the brain.
7. It helps to develop the spirit of teamwork.
8. It helps to improve communication among the team.
SAFETY MEASURES IN PLAYING HOCKEY GAME
1. Inspect all the facilities and equipments.
2. Make sure you use all the kits correctly.
3. Follow the rules of the game.
4. Respect your opponents.
5. Work with your team.
6. Exercise regularly to keep fit for the game.
PRACTICE AND DEMONSTRATE HOCKEY GAME
PRESENTATION
To deliver the lesson, the teacher adopts the following steps:
1. To introduce the lesson, the teacher revises the previous lesson. Based on this, he/she asks the pupils some questions;
2. Displays chart showing ball games.
3. Asks pupils to examine and describe each of the game on the chart.
Pupil’s Activities - Identify the unique difference between each ball game and describe.
4. Uses the chart and pupil’s responses to introduce the lesson.
5. Explains the meaning and types of hockey.
Pupil’s Activities - Pay attention to the lesson introduction to understand and explain the meaning and types of hockey.
6. Narrates the history of hockey in Nigeria.
Pupil’s Activities - Listen to the history of hockey in Nigeria.
7. Uses the chart to mention the facilities and equipments used for playing hockey.
Pupil’s Activities - Use the chart to identify and state the facilities and equipments used for playing hockey.
8. Draws and labels hockey pitch and indicate the appropriate dimensions.
Pupil’s Activities - Draw and labels hockey pitch and indicate the appropriate dimensions.
9. Discuss the advantages and safety measures in playing hockey game.
Pupil’s Activities - Participate actively in the class discussion.
10. Leads a discussion on the basic skills in hockey.
Pupil’s Activities - Participate in the class discussion.
11. Demonstrates each skill in hockey.
Pupil’s Activities - Practice and demonstrate each skill in hockey.
12. Supervises the game as the pupils practice and demonstrate.
13. Summarizes the major points on the board.
Pupil’s Activities - Participate actively in the lesson summary and write as instructed.
CONCLUSION
- To conclude the lesson for the week, the teacher revises the entire lesson and links it to the following week’s lesson  - table tennis.
- Next Lesson -
LESSON EVALUATION
Asks pupils to:
1. narrate the history of hockey in Nigeria;
2. state 5 hockey facilities and equipment;
3. draw and label the hockey pitch with dimensions.
4. perform 5 basic skills in hockey.
5. mention the advantages of playing hockey game.
6. safety measures in playing hockey game.
